profiles.label: Light manufacturing
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with quoted count-bearing phrases such as "workers were inside", "employees were evacuated", "workers were trapped", "employees were rescued", or "inside the factory when" for light manufacturing plants, assembly plants, electronics factories, garment factories, food processing plants, packaging plants, and small industrial workshops. Prioritize news articles, official reports, and labor or safety regulator incident reports; treat production capacity, workforce size, directory, and company profile pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official workplace safety or labor regulator incident report
official company incident statement with a count-bearing detail
context_only_source_types: company profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
production capacity, annual output, or workforce size page
social media repost without an original authoritative source
